scenes.spoken_text: A dining set needs functional and visual coordination across table, chairs and sideboard. Turn those decisions into a traceable drawing, procurement, sample and inspection package.
scenes.caption: A dining set needs functional and visual coordination across table, chairs and sideboard. Turn those decisions into a traceable drawing, procurement, sample and inspection package.

scenes.display_title: Connect the pieces through a use scenario
scenes.spoken_text: Define everyday meals, guests, serving and clearing away. Assign each piece a role and list the sideboard contents and requirement owner. Check chair arms against the table underside and sideboard doors against pulled-out chairs. A matching finish cannot compensate for an incompatible functional interface.
scenes.caption: Review the pieces together in the same use scenario.

scenes.spoken_text: Assign type codes T for table, C for chair and S for sideboard. Record quantity, approved dimensions, material, finish, drawing/revision reference and missing product information. One table, four chairs and one sideboard means 1 + 4 + 1 = 6 physical pieces but three types. Do not confuse quantities with type or drawing counts; distinguish any different chair product.
scenes.caption: Three types, six physical pieces in the exercise.

scenes.display_title: Translate design intent into acceptance criteria
scenes.spoken_text: Code the finish sample and review it alongside chair materials under relevant project lighting. Acceptance criteria should reference approved dimensions and samples, hardware movement, edge quality and seating/serving interfaces. Each piece needs appropriate performance documentation and review. Record defects, owners, corrective actions and reinspection evidence before closing an item.
scenes.caption: Close defects with referenced correction and reinspection evidence.

scenes.spoken_text: Chair C changes to an armchair while its quantity remains four. Its arm no longer clears the underside of table T. The six-piece quantity is still correct, but the functional package is not. Update the chair reference, review the T/C interface and obtain renewed selection approval. Decision: a product change reopens its interfaces even when quantity is unchanged.
scenes.caption: Decision: a product change reopens its interfaces even when quantity is unchanged.

scenes.display_title: Submit a use layout, type/quantity/revision schedule, sample card and one defect/correction record.
scenes.spoken_text: Submit a use layout, type/quantity/revision schedule, sample card and one defect/correction record.
scenes.caption: Submit a use layout, type/quantity/revision schedule, sample card and one defect/correction record.
